title: Recipe
description: A vibrant and comforting curry packed with plant-based protein and wholesome vegetables, perfect for a hearty vegan meal to fuel your new obsession.
name: Sunshine Lentil and Sweet Potato Curry

other.name: Sweet potatoes
other.notes: medium, peeled and cubed into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Stir in the cumin, turmeric, coriander, smoked paprika, and red pepper flakes. Cook for 30 seconds, stirring constantly, to toast the spices.
Add the cubed sweet potatoes, rinsed red lentils, canned diced tomatoes (with their juice), and vegetable broth. Stir everything to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer. Cover and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender and the lentils are cooked through.
Stir in the full-fat coconut milk and the fresh spinach. Cook for another 2-3 minutes, until the spinach has wilted into the curry.
Remove from heat and stir in the fresh lime juice. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro. Delicious with a side of brown rice or vegan naan bread.
notes: For a full vegan day of food and drink, start your morning with overnight oats and a frothy oat milk latte. For a refreshing drink to pair with this curry, try a simple Vegan Mango Lassi: blend 1 cup of mango pulp with 1/2 cup of silken tofu or vegan yogurt, a splash of plant-based milk, and a pinch of cardamom. This curry is also great for meal prep as the flavors deepen overnight.
